description:
Use this when the user wants what RipClip has told them: "any notifications", "are my clips ready", "what
        did I miss", "is there news about my post". Returns the bell's list, newest first: each notification's id,
        kind, title, text, a link into RipClip, when it came and whether it was read, plus how many are unread.
        unread_only: true for just the unread ones. limit: 1 to 50 (default 20).
        Not for: a running job's progress (job_status) or a post's numbers (get_post_stats). Free and read only.
        Next: mark_notifications_read once the user has seen them.
name: list_notifications
title: List my notifications
